doctrine: UPSTREAM DEFINES INTENT. DOWNSTREAM INCREASES FIDELITY.

rules.name: ARCHITECTURAL FRAME
rules.rule: The page sits inside a built place (a wall, a room, a reveal, a niche). Architecture frames the stage from the perimeter; it never sits behind the primary signal as busy texture.
rules.check: ENVIRONMENT zone is full-bleed; PERIMETER zones carry the architecture; reserved regions under L2 / L4 / L5 are quiet surfaces.

rules.name: TACTILE FINANCIAL OBJECT
rules.rule: One made object carries the territory’s metaphor and real data (course lengths, envelope thickness, an inlaid rule). It is contained: 12–50 % of the stage, never the whole page.
rules.check: Exactly one SIGNATURE_OBJECT zone; metaphor_scope OBJECT or ZONE; its data-bearing geometry is deterministic.

rules.name: EDITORIAL HIERARCHY
rules.rule: Function label → state → figure → why. One display figure in the serif; everything else tracked condensed sans capitals. Never more than five type sizes on the page.
rules.check: Focal order starts at PRIMARY_SIGNAL; the figure is the largest type; ≤ 5 sizes.

rules.name: QUIET CENTRAL CLARITY
rules.rule: The primary signal sits in the upper half of the stage on a quiet field and is understood in under two seconds without reading the metaphor.
rules.check: PRIMARY_SIGNAL centre in the upper 60 % of the frame; reserved region edge score ≤ 0.12; 2-second clarity check.

rules.name: PERIPHERAL ENVIRONMENTAL RICHNESS
rules.rule: Richness lives at the edges and in depth: foliage entering the frame, a window reveal, light falling across plaster, the bleed outside the 393-pt viewport. The centre stays legible.
rules.check: PERIMETER zones present on at least two sides; ENVIRONMENT_DEPTH and LIGHT_SHADOW richness ≥ 3.

rules.name: CONTROLLED MATERIAL LAYERING
rules.rule: At most four material families per page (for example plaster, stone, paper, brass). Each one has a job: field, object, inlay, plate. No material appears only as decoration.
rules.check: material families ≤ 4 in the raw generation contract; every material named against a job.

rules.name: BESPOKE GRAPHIC DESIGN
rules.rule: Product modules are designed for this page: survey rules, inlaid proportion rules, plate labels, legend swatches drawn from the object. No stock cards, pills or chart widgets.
rules.check: SECONDARY_PRODUCT zone has a designed component (not a list of cards); CUSTOM_ELEMENTS richness ≥ 3.

rules.name: FUNCTIONAL NEGATIVE SPACE
rules.rule: Empty space is a reserved, named region that does a job (the open floor is what you can spend, the uncut stone is calm). It is never leftover.
rules.check: NEGATIVE_SPACE zones ≥ 6 % of the stage, each with a stated job.

rules.name: SUBTLE WIT
rules.rule: One relationship that rewards a second look (a broken seal, an empty groove, the emptiest space being the money). Never a joke, cute copy or novelty UI.
rules.check: VISUAL_WIT richness ≥ 3; the wit is in the object, not in the copy.

comparison_lessons.lesson: The product read first even though the page was rich.
comparison_lessons.rule: Keep the primary signal on a reserved quiet field in the upper half; richness goes to the perimeter and the object.

comparison_lessons.lesson: The environment framed the page instead of becoming the page.
comparison_lessons.rule: metaphor_scope defaults to OBJECT or ZONE; WHOLE_PAGE needs a founder decision.

comparison_lessons.lesson: Every word, number, icon and nav cell was exact.
comparison_lessons.rule: Precision UI is deterministic (L2, L4–L7 DETERMINISTIC_UI; L1 DETERMINISTIC_VECTOR). The generator never renders text.

comparison_lessons.lesson: The logo was the real mark, placed with intent.
comparison_lessons.rule: The official asset is composited; the scene may give it a surface (plaque, plate, letterhead) but never redraws it.

comparison_lessons.lesson: There was a secondary module with real depth below the signal.
comparison_lessons.rule: Every blueprint has a SECONDARY_PRODUCT zone with real data, so the page is not a number on a wallpaper.

comparison_lessons.lesson: Density was balanced: neither a sparse stack nor a busy poster.
Its copy and features were its own.
comparison_lessons.rule: Its labels (WHY THIS AMOUNT, CHECK A PURCHASE, AVAILABLE THROUGH …) enter only through founder decisions D-F09-PRIMARY-ACTION-LABEL, D-F09-PURCHASES-BRIDGE and D-F09-AVAILABLE-DATE.

density.rule: Product content spans at least two thirds of the stage height; the signature object is 12–50 % of the stage; reserved negative space is ≥ 6 % of the stage; at most four material families and five type sizes.
density.too_sparse: A number, a button and a wallpaper. Correct colours do not make it rich.
density.too_busy: Text competing with texture, an object that eats the stage, more than one focal point above the fold.

geometry.generated_frame_mapping: 9:16 plate: height = 852 pt; the 393-pt viewport is the central 82 % of the plate width (x 9–91 %); the outer 9 % each side is environment bleed only.
